newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Senate panel delays budget amendment vote.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Senate panel delays budget amendment vote.

text.p: The Senate Judiciary Committee postponed one week, until January 30, the vote on the proposed balanced budget amendment to the U.S. Constitution.
Several panel members were absent for the funeral of former Sen. Paul Tsongas.

The committee is expected to recommend approval of the amendment by the full Senate. It has 61 cosponsors, but needs 66 to pass and must pick up five Democratic votes. The White House has pledged a full court press against the amendment and hopes to hold Democratic lawmakers to its side.
